name: touchmac-tooling
description: Lint, format and commit tooling for the TouchMac repo. The app itself builds with SwiftPM in app/.

scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:swift && npm run lint:py && npm run format:check
scripts.lint:swift: swift format lint --strict --recursive app/Sources app/Package.swift tools
scripts.format: prettier --write . && swift format --in-place --recursive app/Sources app/Package.swift tools && ruff format .
scripts.test: cd app && swift run selftest && cd .. && python3 test_touchmac.py
